result.summary: Implemented domain/{venueAuthorization,venue,auditLog}.ts and handlers/venue.ts per the design. All 5 ACs verified with real live-DB grammY dispatch: AC1 member direct-call refused with zero rows created; AC2 cross-chapter refused on both create and edit; AC3 all three field-requirement cases; AC4 future-event deletion refused with the intended message; AC5 exactly one audit_log row per successful mutation, verified by count. Additionally reproduced the flagged RESTRICT-FK tension concretely (not just theoretically): a venue referenced only by a past event surfaces a raw FK-violation error on delete rather than a friendly message -- transaction rolls back cleanly, no invariant violated, but the error shape is wrong for that case. Filed as ISS-0008 for REQ-016 to reconcile. lint/build/test all pass (44/44, up from 18).
